geometry.rule: a single-part parcel keeps its point and outer ring in geometry.json (v3's bytes); a multi-part parcel keeps its point in geometry.json (the address's geometry) and gets one geometry_part_<n>.json per part with its outer ring, each linked by parcel_has_geometry
geometry.lexicon_gap: geometry.polygon holds one ring: inner rings (holes) are not written and are counted in each parcel's sidecar (geometry.inner_rings_dropped)

OBJECTID.note: the layer's row id, kept beside the archive

PROP_ID.note: the join key to the roll (the identifier itself comes from the roll)

geo_id.note: not written: the roll's geo_id is the one kept (sidecar geo_id); its agreement with the layer's is counted in the coverage record

geometry (outer rings).note: one geometry per polygon part (transform v4); a single-part parcel keeps point and polygon in geometry.json

geometry (centroid).note: area-weighted centroid of the outer rings, computed by the seed builder

geometry (inner rings).note: lexicon gap: geometry.polygon has no holes

structure.rule: one structure per property (property_has_structure); a field is written when the account prints exactly one code for its attribute and the code has a member; the structure is written when at least one field is

tax.rule: homestead_cap_loss_amount when ten_percent_cap is positive; per class, the taxable value of the one entity of that class on the account; special districts, exemptions and an account-wide taxable value are not written (TRAVIS_EXPORT_FIELDS_NOT_READ)

prop_type_cd.note: only the first R record of a seed account is read (the seed builder's rule)

sup_num.note: selects the PROP_ENT rows of that record

py_owner_id.note: selects the PROP_ENT rows of that record's owner

ten_percent_cap.note: Ten Percent Homestead Cap Adjustment; written when positive (34,774 accounts), like the agricultural value

entity_name.note: travis-taxing-entity-classes-v1: county, hospital district, college district, ISD, city or village; every other entity counted

taxable_val.note: the one entity of the class on the account; two entities of one class (a split account) leave the field out

partial_entity.note: T when the property is not wholly inside the entity

imprv_id.note: every improvement of the account is read; one structure per property

imprv_attr_desc.note: Roof Covering, Roof Style and Foundation have a lexicon home; Floor, Shape, Grade and Ceiling Factor, Location, Condo Floor and Unique Feature are appraisal factors (counted only)

imprv_attr_cd.note: travis-tcad-extras-mapping-v1 exact-value tables; one printed code per attribute per account, else null

size_acres.note: four implied decimals, summed over segments; written only where the roll prints no legal acreage and it agrees with the square feet within 1%

size_square_feet.note: summed over segments; written only where the roll prints no legal acreage (72,997 of 73,334 such accounts)

export_fields_not_read_with_lexicon_home.field: taxable_val of special districts (ESD, MUD, WCID, PID, road and utility districts)
export_fields_not_read_with_lexicon_home.reason: an account sits in several special districts and the class holds one value; counted in the sidecar (tcad_extras.taxing_entities_other)

export_fields_not_read_with_lexicon_home.field: per-entity exemption amounts (hs_amt, ov65_amt, dv_amt, ex_amt, ...)
export_fields_not_read_with_lexicon_home.reason: exemptions are granted per entity; the account-wide amount is not printed and is not derived
not printed: taxable values are per entity; the per-class fields carry them

a type describes one improvement of several on an account (houses, garage apartments, detail-only rows); no printed value names the property's form or its building count one to one; the codes are kept in the sidecar
the 2026 export prints no exterior-wall attribute (0 of 2,609,059 attribute rows)
